# Dust

Dust is Rust-powered code generation for Dart and Flutter. It helps humans and
AI coding agents build app features with typed generated APIs instead of
handwritten repetitive plumbing.

Primary users: Dart developers, Flutter developers, and coding agents editing
Dart or Flutter apps.

Repository: https://github.com/y3l1n4ung/dust
License: MIT

## Install

macOS/Linux:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/y3l1n4ung/dust/main/install.sh | bash
```

Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/y3l1n4ung/dust/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Installers place `dust` in `$HOME/.local/bin`. Add that directory to `PATH`.

## Packages

- `dust_dart`: Dart annotations/runtime for derives, JSON, validation, HTTP,
  and Database annotations.
- `dust_flutter`: Flutter annotations/runtime for routing, state, and i18n.
- `dust_db_sqlite3`: native SQLite runtime for generated Database code.

## Feature Status

- Stable: data classes, JSON, validation, HTTP clients.
- Beta: routing, state management, i18n, Database.
- Planned: Firebase, Supabase.

Stable `0.1.x` authoring APIs should stay compatible. Beta APIs can still be
refined.

## Common Commands

```bash
dust build
dust check
dust watch
dust clean
dust doctor
dust db build
dust check --db
dust i18n scan
dust i18n build
dust i18n check
```

Run `dust --help` and `dust <command> --help` for current options.

## Generated Files

- Normal generated Dart files use `.g.dart`.
- Do not edit generated files by hand.
- Run `dust build` to write generated files.
- Run `dust check` in CI to verify generated files are current.
- Database code uses `dust db build` and `dust check --db`.

## Examples

- `examples/product_showcase`: Dart derives, JSON, validation, HTTP, and row
  mapping.
- `examples/shopping_app`: Flutter routing, state, i18n, HTTP, and Database.
- `examples/benchmark_project`: large generated input for build and cache
  measurements.

## Repo Map

- `crates/dust_cli`: `dust` command-line interface.
- `crates/dust_driver`: build/check/watch orchestration.
- `crates/dust_parser_dart*`: Dart parsing.
- `crates/dust_resolver`: imports, symbols, annotations, and type resolution.
- `crates/dust_ir`: normalized plugin-facing IR.
- `crates/dust_plugin_*`: feature generators.
- `crates/dust_emitter`: final `.g.dart` assembly.
- `packages/`: public Dart and Flutter runtime packages.
- `examples/`: real proof apps.

## Agent Rules

- Read `AGENTS.md` before making repo changes.
- Never start implementation work on `main`.
- Keep docs factual; do not add unsupported benchmark or release claims.
- Prefer parser/IR facts over plugin-local source-string parsing.
- Keep `dust_dart` Dart-only and `dust_flutter` Flutter-only.
- Routing uses Navigator 2.0 without an external routing package.
- Database is raw SQL with build-time validation, not an ORM.
